notes.title: v0.6 Update
notes.content: [p][b]1. Achievements and Missions[/b][/p][p]We've implemented an achievement system. You can earn achievements by completing in-game missions.[/p][p]You can also obtain in-game currency and items at the same time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45419387/4855224dc76423bc835adc601fdc650a218e0ba9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]2. 3P Animation[/b][/p][p]Currently there is only one H object, but we plan to add more in the future.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45419387/3df5b17fd99eb08042bb93a3163e2879c3797a95.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45419387/f76179619d297ed779e0e73165cb23f10abe2e6f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]3. Outfit Sets[/b][/p][p]You can now purchase outfits as sets and dress up characters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45419387/b1bfb4661906682da988d9fafbf6c2f5dbfe7f5b.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]4. New Items[/b][/p][p]We've implemented items that give experience points to maids, increase rarity, and reset skills.[/p][p]These can be obtained through missions and other means.[/p][p][/p][p][b]5. New Furniture[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45419387/eb9ce68e1a962d8b6e64d8426c63e27320c010cf.png"][/img][/p][p][b]6. New Outfits[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45419387/a9af3ce39833b7b0df83226e53314b50acf63674.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]7. Player Character Auto-Operation[/b][/p][p]Like other maids, player characters can now work automatically.[/p][p][/p][p][b]8. Previous Version Save Data Cannot Be Used[/b][/p][p]We sincerely apologize, but due to the implementation of the achievement feature, save data from previous versions can no longer be used.[/p][p](In future updates, you will be able to continue using your save data)[/p][p][/p][p][b]9. About Future Updates[/b][/p][p]System development is complete with this update. Next, we will add animations and costumes as we work toward the official release.[/p]

notes.title: About Future Updates
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Here are our upcoming update plans.

[list]
[*]Complete H animations

[*]Add languages

[*]Task system, completing tasks will reward:
[list]
[*]New outfits, furniture, etc.
[*]Steam achievements
[*]Also provides an ending to the game, completing all tasks represents full game completion.
[/list]
[*]Others
[list]
[*]Various detail optimizations/bug fixes.
[*]The number of standby maids is not affected by the maid limit - for example, you can have up to 30 maids on standby, while still being limited to using 14 at a time.
[*]Suggestions from the Steam community, such as adding other futa characters, etc.
[/list]
[*]Regarding the Update Schedule
I apologize for not being able to provide an exact schedule. 
This game is developed entirely by myself, and since I'm not a full-time independent game developer, 
I can only work on development during my free time and holidays.
[/list]
Many players in the Steam community have provided valuable opinions and suggestions, 
and I would like to express my sincere gratitude to everyone.
The early access phase of this game is expected to end by the end of this year or early next year. 
After completing the main update content, 
I will try my best to optimize the game based on everyone's suggestions

notes.title: QoL update
notes.content:
This QoL update aims to makes the game easier to play without changing the gameplay itself

[list]
[*]Fullscreen mode has been changed to borderless
[*]Window size can be freely adjusted
[*]Player character name can be changed
[*]You can now give gifts at night, and they will immediately increase Likeability

[*]Anti-aliasing option has been added to the game settings UI

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45419387/e9f93e48e8ec4e51d2e1de4d5ba1b390be2b6dc3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45419387/bda9bd871d087b05c6ee442844fef9afdd908ae2.gif[/img]

[*]The operation menu now automatically updates its available status without needing to be reopened

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45419387/58e1e0b42cf1240c5aa496254c48a285913816a8.gif[/img]

[*]You can place multiple floor tiles simultaneously

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45419387/4e2550aec6e5d8196a786c109addad108ca4ddc4.gif[/img]

[*]A Batch Collection Tool has been added to building mode

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45419387/53291143d0389ede737773c8747f57b168fe5aab.gif[/img]

notes.title: Bug fix for infinite loading & log feature addition
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fix:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Thanks to the help from the community hub, the bug where players were stuck at the initial loading screen and unable to enter the game has been fixed.
[/list]

[h2]Known bugs:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Black screen occurs in H-scenes in some environments.
[*]Black screen and freezing occurs during day/night transitions in some environments.
[/list]
I cannot reproduce these bugs in my environment, and the fix progress is very slow. It would be very helpful if you could send me the logs when you encounter these bugs.

[h2]Log Display Feature:[/h2]

I have added a function to open logs in the game settings page, as shown below:

It would be very helpful if you could enable this feature when reporting bugs in the community hub 
and copy the error logs into your posts.
Reference:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3306200/discussions/0/595139710753454991/#c595139710753495733

(Many games have automatic error log upload functionality. I think I need to implement one in future development as well)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45419387/cc9bbad3968053a7df178c975d88865b2bfd47cc.png[/img]


[h2]Other:[/h2]
Regarding the issue with the 'Large circular bed' not being interactive.

currently there are only 4 H objects with H animations, others are still in development, including 'Large circular bed'.

While it says 'Not implemented ...' in the description, it was not very noticeable, so I've now added 'Not implemented ...' to the name as well.

notes.title: Early Access version has been released!
notes.content:
Hello!
The game is now playable! This is my first release as an independent developer.
While there may be some content limitations and bugs, I will work hard to fix them.
If you discover any bugs, please report them on the Community Hub.
